fact: WHO's annual report for 2025 states that its support that year strengthened Congo's health information system with 401 data collectors equipped for the electronic transmission of data and a national list of health indicators drawn up, and cites DHIS2 data for 2025 showing influenza as the second cause of consultation; it gives no reporting completeness or timeliness and does not say at which tier the collectors work.
title: Rapport annuel 2025 - OMS au Congo
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau pays du Congo
